m: Rub the chicken with the paprika, cumin, oregano, garlic, oil and salt. Leave 15 minutes.
Cook the rice. Stir through lime juice and chopped coriander.
Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred. Rest and slice.
Warm the drained black beans with a pinch of cumin and salt.
Salsa: corn, chopped tomatoes, red onion, jalapeño, lime and coriander.
Build bowls: rice, beans, chicken, salsa, cheese, sour cream and avocado.
l: Built for lunch. Keep the sour cream and avo separate until eating.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the spice labels.
